verdict: Ad returns are accelerating; key project milestones need to catch up.
narrative: This period, your Meta ads delivered a 4.95 return on ad spend against $1,397.80 in spend, with purchases up 40% week-over-week — the budget is working efficiently at its current level. That purchase growth is coming from direct ecommerce traffic, which is a healthy sign for the store. On the project side, 7 agreed milestones are overdue — including the funnel test, UTM tracking, subscribe pages, and CRM flows — and closing those is the priority focus heading into November. Your Google Business Profile also went quiet on October 24–25 after a strong 26-day run, and that is being checked now to confirm whether it is a data gap or a profile issue.
